overview: Discover the beauty of Kashmir with a holiday filled with stunning mountain views, peaceful lakes, lush green valleys, and memorable local experiences. Our Kashmir tour package options help you plan a trip that suits your budget, travel dates, and interests. Whether you are planning a family vacation, a romantic honeymoon, or an adventure with friends, Kashmir offers something special in every season. Explore famous destinations, choose comfortable hotels, and enjoy a well-planned itinerary with flexible travel options. Ready to plan your Kashmir holiday? Explore our packages and find the right trip for your next getaway.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake
itinerary.description:
Arrival at Srinagar Airport. Meet and greet by a Safar Trails representative. Private transfer to your hotel or houseboat and check-in. Freshen up and relax after your journey.

Enjoy an evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake. Explore the Dal Lake surroundings and enjoy leisure time along Boulevard Road. Dinner and overnight stay in Srinagar.
itinerary.morningActivity: Arrival at Srinagar Airport & meet and greet by Safar Trails representative
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Private transfer to hotel or houseboat, check-in & relax
itinerary.eveningActivity: Evening Shikara ride on Dal Lake & walk along Boulevard Road
itinerary.stay: Overnight Stay: Srinagar (Hotel or Traditional Houseboat)
itinerary.insiderTip: Take in the peaceful reflections of the Zabarwan range during your sunset Shikara ride across Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Srinagar's famous Mughal Gardens: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh and Chashme Shahi.

Visit Shankaracharya Temple, subject to access and timings. Visit Hazratbal Shrine and Pari Mahal. Enjoy local shopping at Srinagar market for authentic Kashmiri handicrafts, dry fruits, and souvenirs. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay in Srinagar.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast and visit to Mughal Gardens (Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi)
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit Shankaracharya Temple, Hazratbal Shrine & historic Pari Mahal
itinerary.eveningActivity: Local shopping at Srinagar market; return for dinner & overnight stay
itinerary.insiderTip: Pari Mahal offers exceptional elevated views over Dal Lake and the Royal Springs golf course in the late afternoon.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Gulmarg and enjoy scenic Himalayan landscapes along the way. Explore the beautiful Gulmarg meadow and spend leisure time amid the mountains.

Optional: Gulmarg Gondola ride; tickets are subject to availability and weather conditions. Optional snow activities or pony ride, depending on season and local availability. Return to Srinagar for dinner and overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast and scenic mountain drive to Gulmarg
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Gulmarg meadow; optional Gondola cable car ride (subject to tickets & weather)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional snow activities or nature walk; return to Srinagar for dinner
itinerary.insiderTip: Gulmarg Gondola tickets sell out rapidly during peak seasons; book early online or confirm ticket assistance with our team.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam – Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Drive towards Pahalgam, enjoying views of the Kashmir Valley en route. Visit the saffron fields at Pampore, seasonal.

Explore Betaab Valley and Aru Valley. Visit Chandanwari, subject to local vehicle rules, access restrictions and weather. Return towards Srinagar in the evening. Dinner and overnight stay in Srinagar.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast and drive towards Pahalgam with stop at Pampore saffron fields
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and scenic Lidder river banks
itinerary.eveningActivity: Visit Chandanwari (subject to access); drive back to Srinagar for dinner
itinerary.transfers: Private Chauffeur Cab (+ local union cab where required)
itinerary.insiderTip: Betaab Valley is surrounded by lush meadows and snow-covered peaks, named after the Bollywood hit film shot here.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Sonamarg – Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Sonamarg, known as the “Meadow of Gold.” Enjoy scenic mountain views and leisure time in the valley.

Visit the Thajiwas Glacier area, subject to weather and local access. Optional pony ride, subject to availability. Return to Srinagar for dinner and overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast and drive through scenic Sindh Valley to Sonamarg
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Leisure time in the meadow & excursion to Thajiwas Glacier area
itinerary.eveningActivity: Optional pony ride; return to Srinagar for dinner and overnight stay
itinerary.insiderTip: The drive along the Sindh River to Sonamarg passes through dramatic rocky gorges and alpine forests.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Breakfast at the hotel. Check out from the hotel. Enjoy free time for shopping or leisure, depending on your flight schedule.

Private transfer to Srinagar Airport. Depart with beautiful memories of Kashmir.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast at hotel and check-out formalities
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Free time for shopping / leisure depending on flight schedule

topPlacesToVisit.name: Srinagar – Lakes, Gardens, and Local Culture
topPlacesToVisit.description: Srinagar is an excellent starting point for a Kashmir holiday. Its lakes, gardens, traditional architecture, and local markets make it appealing to first-time visitors. Enjoy a Shikara ride on Dal Lake, walk through the Mughal Gardens, or explore shops selling Kashmiri handicrafts. You can also try regional dishes and warm Kahwa tea during your stay.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Gulmarg – Mountain Views and Snow Adventures
topPlacesToVisit.description: Gulmarg is known for its mountain scenery, meadows, and winter sports. During the warmer months, visitors can enjoy green landscapes and outdoor excursions. In winter, snow can transform the area into a popular destination for seasonal activities. The Gulmarg Gondola offers spectacular views when operating. Tickets, weather conditions, and access should be checked before travel.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Pahalgam – Valleys and Riverside Scenery
topPlacesToVisit.description: Pahalgam is a wonderful choice for travelers who enjoy peaceful landscapes and time outdoors. The surrounding area features rivers, forests, and mountain views. Depending on local access and your itinerary, you may visit places such as Betaab Valley or Aru Valley. Allow enough time for travel between attractions rather than trying to cover everything in a single day.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Sonamarg – An Alpine Escape
topPlacesToVisit.description: Sonamarg is admired for its mountain scenery, open landscapes, and seasonal excursions. It is a rewarding addition for travelers who want to experience another side of Kashmir. Road conditions and seasonal restrictions can affect access, so confirm local arrangements before including Sonamarg in your plans.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Doodhpathri and Yusmarg – Peaceful Natural Landscapes
topPlacesToVisit.description: For travelers looking beyond the best-known destinations, Doodhpathri and Yusmarg offer scenic surroundings and a quieter atmosphere. These locations can be considered for customized itineraries, depending on the time available, transport arrangements, and current road conditions.

thingsToDo: Shikara ride: Take a relaxing ride across Dal Lake and enjoy views of the surrounding mountains and lakeside life.
Houseboat stay: Experience a traditional style of accommodation on Dal Lake or another designated lake area.
Gondola ride: Admire the mountain scenery around Gulmarg when the cable car is operating.
Snow activities: Depending on the season and local conditions, consider skiing, snowboarding, or playing in the snow.
Nature walks: Spend time exploring meadows and scenic surroundings at a comfortable pace.
Local food: Try Kashmiri specialties such as Rogan Josh, Yakhni, and Kahwa at suitable local establishments.
Shopping: Look for traditional handicrafts, carpets, papier-mâché products, and locally made souvenirs.
hotelsAndStays:
Choosing the right accommodation can make a noticeable difference to your trip. The ideal stay depends on your budget, preferred comfort level, sightseeing plans, and the people traveling with you.

• Luxury Hotels: Luxury properties are suitable for travelers who value premium amenities, attentive service, and comfortable rooms. Some properties offer scenic views, restaurants, wellness facilities, or upscale dining.

• Budget Hotels: Budget accommodation can help keep your overall holiday cost manageable. Compare room facilities, cleanliness, location, heating arrangements during colder months, and recent guest reviews before confirming a reservation.

• Traditional Houseboats: A houseboat stay is a distinctive way to experience Dal Lake. Before booking, confirm the exact location, room category, meals, heating, transfer arrangements, and whether a Shikara transfer is included.

• Resorts and Cottages: Resorts and cottages may appeal to travelers looking for a peaceful atmosphere away from busy town centers. Check road access, nearby restaurants, transport availability, and the distance to planned attractions.

• Family and Couple-Friendly Stays: Families may prefer spacious rooms and convenient access to restaurants and sightseeing. Couples may look for privacy, scenic surroundings, and a comfortable setting for a relaxing holiday.

Accommodation tip: Ask for the hotel names or confirmed category, room type, meal plan, and cancellation terms in writing before paying your booking amount.

bestTimeToVisit.description: Spring brings blooming gardens, fresh greenery, and pleasant opportunities for sightseeing. It is a good period for visitors interested in gardens, photography, and exploring Srinagar.
Summer is popular for family holidays, mountain scenery, and outdoor sightseeing. This season can be busy, so compare accommodation options and confirm bookings early.
Autumn brings beautiful seasonal colors to many landscapes. It is an appealing time for photography, scenic drives, and a more relaxed holiday, although conditions vary by destination.

Winter attracts travelers hoping to experience snow and seasonal activities, particularly around Gulmarg. Temperatures can be low, and snowfall may affect roads and travel plans. Choose accommodation with suitable heating and check weather updates before departure.

faqs.question: How many days are enough for a Kashmir trip?
faqs.answer: Five to seven days is a useful starting point for visiting Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam, with time for an additional excursion if conditions and travel times allow. Shorter trips can focus on Srinagar and nearby attractions.

faqs.question: What is the cost of a Kashmir tour package?
faqs.answer: The total cost depends on travel dates, group size, hotel category, transportation, meals, and activities. Request a personalized quotation based on your actual travel requirements instead of relying on a general price estimate.

faqs.question: Which destinations should I include in my Kashmir itinerary?
faqs.answer: Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam are popular starting choices. Sonamarg, Doodhpathri, and Yusmarg may also be suitable, depending on your available days and current access conditions.

faqs.question: Is a Kashmir tour package suitable for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Families can choose comfortable hotels, suitable transport, and a flexible sightseeing schedule. Consider travel time, weather, walking requirements, and children's needs when selecting destinations.

faqs.question: Can couples book a honeymoon package?
faqs.answer: Yes. Couples can request romantic accommodation, a houseboat stay, scenic sightseeing, and optional experiences. Confirm privacy, room arrangements, meals, and any additional charges before booking.

faqs.question: Are flights included in the package price?
faqs.answer: Flights are not automatically included. Check your quotation to see whether airfare, airport transfers, baggage-related costs, and other transport arrangements are covered.

faqs.question: Is the Gulmarg Gondola ride included?
faqs.answer: Only if it is specifically listed in your package. Ticket availability and operating schedules may change, so verify the latest arrangements before traveling.

faqs.question: What should I pack for Kashmir?
faqs.answer: Pack comfortable walking shoes, clothing suited to the season, a warm jacket, and rain protection where appropriate. Winter travelers should bring suitable thermal layers and check the expected conditions for each destination.

faqs.question: Can I customize my travel itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes, a customized itinerary can be designed around your travel dates, group size, preferred destinations, accommodation budget, and activity interests, subject to availability and local restrictions.

faqs.question: How can I confirm a hotel or houseboat booking?
faqs.answer: Ask for written confirmation with the property name, location, room category, check-in dates, meal plan, payment terms, and cancellation conditions. Keep a copy of the confirmation for your journey.

faqs.question: Is Kashmir safe to visit?
faqs.answer: Travel conditions can change. Review current official travel advisories, weather forecasts, local guidance, and road conditions before departure. Follow instructions from local authorities and your travel provider.

faqs.question: When should I book my Kashmir holiday?
faqs.answer: Booking early can give you more accommodation and transport choices during busy travel periods. However, the right booking time depends on your dates, budget, and cancellation flexibility.
